unverified: Official CTDOT OSTA speeds are applied only for Lake Avenue, Stanwich Road, and North Street (the Greenwich roads asked in the 2026-11-16 check). Westover Road in this map is in Stamford; the Stamford OSTA list posts it 25 mph. School-hours and when-flashing limits on those roads are not used as the all-day posted speed. Other roads still use OSM or inferred speeds. Untagged residential streets without an official override are assumed 25 mph. I-95 and the Merritt Parkway stay banned.
